name: Mafia's Tea Party
source:
Three of the most prominent Mafia group leaders gather for an emergency meeting. What could have made them gather so urgently in the middle of the night?

[From [url=https://wildwildnt.itch.io/mafias-tea-party-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
三位最著名的黑手党领导人聚集在一起召开紧急会议。是什么让他们在半夜如此紧急地聚集在一起？

[来自[url=https://wildwildnt.itch.io/mafias-tea-party-prologue]Itch.io[/url]]
